title: Yogeshwar B K
tagline: HubShare- A decentralized file share system with decryption to share files between users
description: HubShare-It is a decentralized file sharing platform which uses IPFS protocol to send files securely and the files can be retrieved only by the user with the hash generated by the application.It uses metamask to transact gases and confirm the transactions.The transaction Receipt can be seen in the application
how_its_made: The project's frontend is made by React and the backend code is written in IPFS.The file share algorithm is written in solidity language with the use of IPFS hash.It also uses web3.The frontend uses the react-bootstrap to make it look more elagant.It also has crypto.js to hash the files.
